rules.rule: Never log, include in an error message, or write to a test fixture the real api_key/apiKey value in plaintext. Test fixtures should use an obviously-fake key.

This SDK ships in Python, Rust, and TypeScript with a mirrored resource surface. A new or changed API method/endpoint added in one language's resources should generally be mirrored in the other two, unless there's a stated language-specific reason not to.
This package uses uv for dependency management (uv.lock present). Don't suggest bare pip/poetry commands for installing or running.
The TypeScript SDK is Deno-native (deno.json, deno.lock) and published to JSR/npm. Don't suggest npm install/npm test — use deno task equivalents.
